Une plateforme d'expression pour les jeu: A platform of expression for young creators
Ooredoo Algérie a officiellement lancé s: Ooredoo Algeria has officially launched its "Born to be DZ – The Artistic Contest", a national competition dedicated to young Algerian talents. Headlined by the international Algerian artist DJ Snake, this initiative highlights the country's cultural, historical, and identity diversity.
Le concours s'adresse aux Algériens de t: The competition is open to Algerians across the entire territory and runs from August 18 to September 17, 2026. Participants are invited to create original works inspired by the national heritage in one of five proposed categories: Photography, Music, Art & Design, Cinema & Comedy, as well as Dance & Performance.
Les candidatures seront jugées par un ju: Applications will be judged by a panel composed of renowned figures, whose names will be revealed on the operator's social media. The finalists will then be subject to a public vote via the My Ooredoo application, which will determine five winners, one per category.
Chaque gagnant recevra une récompense de: Each winner will receive a reward of 1,000,000 DZD in recognition of their contribution to promoting Algerian heritage through art. Entries can be submitted online on the borntobedz.ooredoo.dz platform, where the rules, procedures, and detailed information are available.
À travers cette initiative, Ooredoo Algé: Through this initiative, Ooredoo Algeria reaffirms its role as a corporate citizen by supporting youth and placing Algerian culture at the heart of artistic expression. The contest is part of an approach to promoting local talent and shining a light on national identity.
